title: Marty Fox buys A$4.2 million home; says softer conditions favour buyers
summary_full: Marty Fox, known from The Block, purchased a five-bedroom home in Burleigh Heads for A$4.2 million. The property is set for major renovations and is located near the beach. Fox believes the current market presents an excellent buying opportunity despite declining prices. He emphasizes a new investment strategy that focuses on renting fully renovated homes. His previous home will transition into a luxury holiday rental, contributing to his adjusted approach.
